literal_question_entire_original_object.question: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?

asked_fact_map_entire_original_row.question: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?
required_facts: The added Town stays next turn as a board change.
The turn's Build-skip effect expires at Time Passes.
Discard played cards to personal discard and clear card Elements.
Heal survivor Damage and remove temporary effects/reminder markers.

fixed_key_entire_original_row.answer: Added Town remains as a board change. Build skip expires at Time Passes. Played cards go to personal discard, all surviving Invader/Dahan Damage clears, card Elements and temporary effects clear, reminder markers removed. Track Elements remain while uncovered.

interpretation: Town persists; this-turn Build skip expires; personal-discard destination, survivor Damage clearance, reminder removal and uncovered track Elements remain are all required. Card Element expiration is correct explanatory background bundled into mapped fact3, but the literal prompt specifically asks track Elements rather than card Elements. Its omission is not an extra requirement. No mapped fact index is skipped; fact3 is assessed for the actually requested personal-discard result.
not_general_waiver: If another literal question asks card Element expiration, that result must be supplied. Material false extra claims still count.
